package.purpose: Starter Cerebral model for text, coding, mathematics, English writing, and native image understanding
package.notes: Includes the matching Qwen3.5-9B vision projector used by Cerebral's native llama.cpp image path. Automatic memory fitting may reduce context, GPU layers, or offload work to system RAM on a 6-8 GB GPU. The projector is from the Apache-2.0 Qwen3.5 GGUF family and is retained as projector.gguf inside this portable package.

model.name: Qwen 3.5 9B
model.description: General-purpose multimodal Qwen3.5-9B starter weights in GGUF Q5_K_M quantization with a matching native vision projector. Cerebral shares one loaded model among multiple agent contexts and automatically fits context and GPU layers to available memory.
model.metadataSource: package; verified again from GGUF during import
